verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a localhost API bundled with the desktop app, a versioned OpenAPI spec, and an official MCP server for AI assistants. A CLI runs Anytype as a headless server for automation, and an agents skill lets Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools read, search and modify Objects, including bulk edits. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that headless read/write works as documented (all evidence is first-party, and API v2 is still pre-release).
